title: V6.2 Stage 2: Thesis + Decision (grounded in Stage 1 output)
description: Stage 2 receives the case packet, the calibrated numerical forecasts (as a prior, not an admission rule), and the Stage 1 evidence_observations array (already validated -- ids and exact_observations are trustworthy inputs at this point). Stage 2 forms a thesis and a decision. It must ground every claim in a specific evidence_id from Stage 1's output; it may not introduce new factual claims about the evidence.

evidence_quality.description: Scored only from Stage 1's per-family direction/timeliness/limitations for case_available families. Never scored by counting how many of the 10 registry families are present.

primary_evidence_ids.description: Must be a subset of Stage 1's evidence_observations[*].evidence_id whose direction is SUPPORTIVE (or MIXED with a supportive component described in exact_observations).

secondary_evidence_ids.description: Subset of Stage 1 evidence_ids providing weaker/contextual support.

counter_evidence_ids.description: Must be a subset of Stage 1's evidence_observations[*].evidence_id whose direction is CONTRADICTORY (or MIXED with a contradictory component). If bear_thesis references any evidence family's negative aspect, that family's id MUST appear here -- deterministically checked downstream.

system_limitations.description: Must exactly equal the system_unavailable_evidence_ids supplied for this case. Transparency-only.
